user.title: Marstek BLE
user.description: Home Assistant scans the currently known connectable BLE devices, including Bluetooth proxies. CT002 and Venus devices can be selected independently; at least one device is required. MAC addresses can still be entered manually.

data_description.ct_mac: Optional. Detected CT002 units appear as MST-TPM_… with their Bluetooth MAC. The MAC can be entered manually if needed.
data_description.venus_devices: Select one or more detected Venus devices. Each selected device can then be named individually.
data_description.ct_poll_interval: Only used when a CT002 is configured. Default and recommended: 5 s. Allowed: 1 to 300 s.
data_description.venus_poll_interval: Default: 150 s. Each cycle reads all selected Venus devices sequentially.

confirm_fast_poll.title: Confirm fast CT002 polling
confirm_fast_poll.description: You selected {seconds} seconds. Below {recommended} seconds, BLE and device load increase significantly and some CT002 units may become unstable. The integration deliberately does not impose a higher minimum. Submit to confirm that you want to use this interval at your own risk.

error.invalid_mac: At least one Bluetooth MAC address is invalid.
error.empty_name: The name must not be empty.
error.no_devices: Select at least one CT002 or Venus device.

abort.already_configured: This Marstek BLE configuration already exists.

init.title: Marstek BLE options
init.description: CT002 and Venus devices can be added or removed independently. Home Assistant shows detected devices from the Bluetooth manager, including proxies. Already configured devices remain selectable even when they are not currently seen. The integration reloads automatically after saving.

data_description.ct_mac: Optional. Select, change, or remove it. Without a CT002 the integration runs with the configured Venus devices only.
data_description.ct_poll_interval: Only used when a CT002 is configured. Default and recommended: 5 s. Allowed: 1 to 300 s.
data_description.venus_poll_interval: Default: 150 s. One poll reads all selected Venus devices sequentially.
data_description.venus_devices: Select, add, or remove devices. Each selected device can then be named individually.

confirm_fast_poll.title: Confirm fast CT002 polling
confirm_fast_poll.description: You selected {seconds} seconds. Below {recommended} seconds, BLE and device load increase significantly and some CT002 units may become unstable. The integration deliberately does not impose a higher minimum. Submit to confirm that you want to use this interval at your own risk.

error.invalid_mac: At least one Bluetooth MAC address is invalid.
error.empty_name: The name must not be empty.
error.no_devices: Select at least one CT002 or Venus device.
